summary: Complaints centre on waterlogging when drains overflow onto Syana's main roads and bazaar, congestion on the narrow Syana road into the market, and a power cut during rain; the positives are planned road widening and a drain response, none yet a completed benefit.

positives.english: *Syana to Garh road is set to be widened
positives.hindi: *स्याना से गढ़ तक की सड़क चौड़ी होने वाली है
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (11 Dec 2025) says the Syana-Garh road (SH-65, km 6 to 24, 19 km, Rs 59 crore) was approved; Amar Ujala (24 Jan 2026) says the 19 km Bulandshahr-Syana state highway widening (Rs 58.91 crore, 7 m to 10 m) had its tender completed and construction would begin in February. Start of work is not verified and nothing shows it was completed. Highway name differs between the two reports

positives.english: *Syana-Simbhaoli road widening has got its first funds
positives.hindi: *स्याना-सिंभावली सड़क चौड़ी करने के लिए पैसा जारी हो गया है
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (28 Sep 2026) says the government approved a Rs 14.44 crore estimate for the 7.35 km road and released Rs 7.22 crore as first instalment, with tender still to come. Only approval and funds are reported, no work done. AC membership of the Bibinagar-Simbhaoli-NH-9 route is unconfirmed

positives.english: *Sanitation staff were sent to drain water from waterlogged spots in Syana
positives.hindi: *जलभराव वाली जगहों से पानी निकालने के लिए सफाईकर्मी भेजे गए
positives.basis: Inference: Syana Executive Officer Sevaram Rajbhar is quoted (Amar Ujala, 23 Aug 2026) saying sanitation workers were sent to waterlogged places to drain the water. This is the official's claim only; the article reports no resident reaction in its favour

positives.english: *Rain has helped crops and eased the humidity a little
positives.hindi: *बारिश से फसलों को फायदा और उमस में कुछ राहत मिली
positives.basis: Inference: a meteorologist at the Krishi Vigyan Kendra says the rain is proving a boon for crops and eases heat and humidity (Amar Ujala, 3 Jul 2026, Bugrasi and Syana report). This is a weather comment, not a project; it is district-level commentary carried in a Syana-area report

positives.english: *Most of Bulandshahr city's drains are now covered
positives.hindi: *शहर के ज़्यादातर नाले अब ढके हुए हैं
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (14 Aug 2026) says about 70% of the roughly 45 km of drains in Bulandshahr city are covered and Rs 1.20 crore is proposed for the rest. This is Bulandshahr city, not Syana, so it is outside this AC and is district-level context only

negatives.english: Rain turns Syana's bazaars and main roads into waterlogged streets as drains overflow
negatives.hindi: बारिश होते ही नालियों का पानी सड़कों और बाजार में भर जाता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (23 Aug 2026): in Syana, low-lying areas, main roads and markets were waterlogged and drain water was seen flowing onto the roads; residents blamed silt and dirt in the drains and asked for a permanent drainage system. Amar Ujala (3 Jul 2026, Bugrasi and Syana report) says drains overflowed within minutes and shops flooded. Amar Ujala (18 Jul 2026) says Syana's lanes were submerged and vehicles broke down in the water

negatives.english: Syana market gets jammed because the road into it is too narrow
negatives.hindi: स्याना बाजार में अक्सर जाम लगता है, सड़क बहुत संकरी है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (24 Jan 2026): the Bulandshahr-Syana state highway is 7 m wide, congestion is frequent, and Aurangabad and Syana are named as towns with congested main markets. About 10,000 vehicles and roughly 60,000 people use the road daily. The earlier 5 km widening did not solve the problem

negatives.english: The power also went off in Syana during the rain
negatives.hindi: बारिश में स्याना की बिजली भी गुल हो गई
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (18 Jul 2026): power supply was cut off in Syana during the rain, while the rain also flooded lanes and students returning from school faced difficulty. Reported for one rain event only

negatives.english: Syana-Simbhaoli road is still only about 3.5 metres wide
negatives.hindi: स्याना-सिंभावली सड़क अभी सिर्फ साढ़े तीन मीटर चौड़ी है
negatives.basis: AC membership unconfirmed. Amar Ujala (28 Sep 2026): the road is currently about 3.50 to 3.75 m wide and will be raised to 5.50 m. The article describes the route from Bibinagar through Simbhaoli to NH-9, so it is not confirmed to lie inside Syana AC. The article reports no public complaint

negatives.english: Khurja's GT road has potholes and waterlogging because it has no drain
negatives.hindi: खुर्जा में जीटी रोड पर नाली नहीं, इसलिए गड्ढे और जलभराव
negatives.basis: District-level, not Syana AC. Amar Ujala (30 Sep 2026), Khurja, Bulandshahr district: about 7 km of GT road built for about Rs 14 crore has waterlogging at several points, potholes, and no drain; PWD says only renovation and widening were sanctioned

notes: Identity confirmed from the Wikipedia Syana Assembly constituency page: No. 66, Syana, Bulandshahr district, reserved status None, extent Syana Tehsil. The statewide list page was also opened and gives the same name, district and reserved status. Negatives 1 to 3 are confirmed inside Syana town or the highway into it. Positives are all flagged inference: no completed or verified-started AC-specific benefit was found. Shikarpur reports (waterlogging, mandi maize loss) were excluded because Shikarpur is not confirmed inside Syana Tehsil. Bugrasi and Naveen Mandi were excluded because their AC membership is unconfirmed. Bulandshahr city items (Charu drowning, Kala Aam-Syana Adda road, Bhuteshwar temple drain) were excluded as city, not AC. The Syana-Garh road is named SH-65 km 6 to 24 in the Dec 2025 report and as the Bulandshahr-Syana state highway in the Jan 2026 report; the two reports differ on the name and the Rs 90 crore headline does not match the Rs 100 crore sum of its items. No Syana water supply, CHC, stray-cattle, or school report was found in the searches; the Hindi and English queries returned nothing AC-specific on those topics. Field check: whether the Syana-Garh widening has actually started; drain status in Syana market and Kotwali Road; and whether power cuts during rain are regular.
